_note: The universal upstream error envelope. `code` is the field to branch on -- never the message text. For 409 the code is `concurrent_session`, and its real meaning is a COUNT problem: the account already holds the maximum number of live sessions, NOT that someone else is mid-request.

concurrent_session.message: You've already got 4 free-pi CLI sessions running. Run /close-other-session to clear them, then retry.

_session_cap_source: hungkevin/free-pi-cli-proxy server.mjs:958 — 'free-pi.ai limits each account to at most 4 concurrent sessions'
_note_on_cap: We deliberately occupy ONE of these four (see plan section 2): the session id is derived from account identity, so every connection and every process converges on the same session. The other three stay unspent headroom.
